title: Stage 05 — tablet controls and safe pause
platform: Tablet browser layouts at 1024×768 and 768×1024; Windows executable update in the existing isolated QA profile
summary: The final tablet audit found 24px drawing controls. They now measure at least 44×44 and wrap within the drawing area. Both orientations retain the saved original page and viewport centre. The updated Windows executable reopened the prior test project, two price books, sheet groups, saved view and backup. Work pauses here at the user's request.

requirements.change: Eight lower controls pass size, viewport bounds and centre hit tests in both tablet orientations. Source page and centre stay correct after resize and reload.
requirements.remaining: Actual tablet hardware and other browser engines still require their own testing. Phones are excluded.

requirements.change: The previous isolated profile retained its job, 13 sheets, two price books, saved view and verified backup when reopened in the new executable.
requirements.remaining: This is not an installed-app upgrade or full restore; normal user data was untouched.

requirements.change: Current build-cad.mjs refuses non-Windows platforms and is required by the native beforeBuildCommand.
requirements.remaining: Provide a platform-aware DWG translator/build path, then build and test each native package. No compatibility claim is made.
